```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-kv-memory
#| fig-cap: "Memory efficiency across three scales: CoordKV2 fixed-cost amortization vs proportional scaling of CoordKVN and HashMap."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

scales = ['10k entries', '1M entries', '10M entries']
x = np.arange(len(scales))

# CoordKV2: 119 MB fixed regardless of entries
# CoordKVN<2>: ~45 B/entry tree overhead
# HashMap: ~51 B/entry + resize overhead

# Per-entry memory (B)
kv2_b = [119 * 1024 * 1024 / 10_000, 119 * 1024 * 1024 / 1_000_000, 119 * 1024 * 1024 / 10_000_000]
kvn_b = [45, 45, 45]
hm_b  = [51, 55, 62]  # HashMap overhead increases with resize

# Total memory (MB) — log scale
kv2_mb = [119, 119, 119]
kvn_mb = [0.45, 45, 450]
hm_mb  = [0.51, 55, 620]

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(8, 3.5))

# Left: Per-entry cost (linear)
ax1.plot(x, kv2_b, '-o', color='black', markerfacecolor='white', markeredgecolor='black',
         markersize=7, linewidth=1.5, label='CoordKV2 (dense)')
ax1.plot(x, kvn_b, '-^', color='black', markerfacecolor='white', markeredgecolor='gray',
         markersize=7, linewidth=1.5, label='CoordKVN<2> (tree)')
ax1.plot(x, hm_b, '-s', color='black', markerfacecolor='black', markeredgecolor='black',
         markersize=7, linewidth=1.5, label='HashMap')
ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(scales, fontsize=7.5)
ax1.set_ylabel('Memory per entry (B)', fontsize=9)
ax1.set_yscale('log')
ax1.legend(fontsize=7, loc='upper right')
ax1.grid(axis='y', linestyle=':', alpha=0.3)

# Annotation: crossover point
ax1.axvline(x=1.5, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5)
ax1.text(1.55, 50, 'CoordKV2 becomes\nmore efficient\nthan HashMap here',
         fontsize=6.5, color='gray', ha='left')

# Right: Total memory (log)
ax2.plot(x, kv2_mb, '-o', color='black', markerfacecolor='white', markeredgecolor='black',
         markersize=7, linewidth=1.5, label='CoordKV2 (dense)')
ax2.plot(x, kvn_mb, '-^', color='black', markerfacecolor='white', markeredgecolor='gray',
         markersize=7, linewidth=1.5, label='CoordKVN<2> (tree)')
ax2.plot(x, hm_mb, '-s', color='black', markerfacecolor='black', markeredgecolor='black',
         markersize=7, linewidth=1.5, label='HashMap')
ax2.set_xticks(x)
ax2.set_xticklabels(scales, fontsize=7.5)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total memory (MB)', fontsize=9)
ax2.set_yscale('log')
ax2.legend(fontsize=7, loc='upper left')
ax2.grid(axis='y', linestyle=':', alpha=0.3)

for xi, y1, y2, y3 in zip(x, kv2_mb, kvn_mb, hm_mb):
    ax2.text(xi, y1 * 1.5, f'{y1}', fontsize=7, ha='center', color='black')
    ax2.text(xi - 0.1, y2 * 1.5, f'{y2:.0f}', fontsize=7, ha='center', color='black')
    ax2.text(xi + 0.1, y3 * 1.5, f'{y3:.0f}', fontsize=7, ha='center', color='black')

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```
